case_file.title: Records vault entry during a busy shift
case_file.investigation_objective: Establish why Jordan Pell entered Records Vault B-12 at 14:07 on 12 March 2026, whether the entry had an assigned task, and why the vault door was held open from 14:09 to 14:12.

interview_context.setting: Interview room 2, Office of Facility Security, Halvern Street Annex. The subject attends during work hours; the interview is administrative and voluntary.
interview_context.investigator_role: Internal review officer, Office of Facility Security
interview_context.purpose_statement: This is an administrative fact-finding interview about the access exception recorded for Records Vault B-12 on 12 March 2026. No conclusion has been reached.

known_timeline.event: Facilities shift began with two of four technicians absent.
Jordan Pell's badge opened Records Vault B-12.
B-12 door closed and the alarm cleared.
End-of-day roster check flagged the B-12 entry as an access exception.

initial_documents.title: Access exception report, Records Vault B-12, 12 March 2026

content.body: Generated 16:00 by the end-of-day roster check (O. Varga, Records Vault Custodian). Exception: B-12 is not on J. Pell's daily task roster. Badge 30418 last opened B-12 on 19 November 2025. No other B-12 badge entries on 12 March. The B-12 exit does not require a badge, so no exit time is recorded.

initial_documents.title: Records Vault B-12 access rules (Facility Security Standard 4.2)

content.body: Entry to B-12 requires an assigned task: an open work order or a supervisor dispatch recorded on the radio log. Staff must not hold the vault door open longer than 60 seconds except while moving equipment, and must stay at the open door. Sealed records boxes may be opened only by the custodian or under a signed custodian release.
Supervisor on duty: I. Marrow. Scheduled technicians: J. Pell, D. Rusk, K. Okafor-Lyle, S. Tamsin. Absent: D. Rusk (sick leave), S. Tamsin (training). Technicians on shift: J. Pell, K. Okafor-Lyle.

requestable_records.description: Alarm panel history for B-wing rooms: room, alarm type, time raised and time cleared.

requestable_records.description: End-of-day seal audit by the vault custodian: sealed boxes checked against the seal register, and the seal supply drawer log.
